meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先补回归测试锁住现有行为，再按九类 AI 味（啰嗦注释、过度防御、死代码等）清理改动过的文件，最后跑测试、lint、类型检查等质量闸门验证，验证不过就回滚。
howto.when: 当你说“清理”、“deslop”、“去掉 AI 味”等，或要求处理最近改动时触发。默认范围是当前分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff，也可以只传一组文件。

say.text: 把当前分支相对 main 的改动做一次 deslop 清理
say.note: 先补测试锁定行为，再逐类清理并验证

say.text: 清理这几个文件里的 AI 味：src/foo.py、src/bar.py
say.note: 以传入的文件列表作为处理范围

say.text: 清理后跑一遍回归测试和质量闸门
say.note: 不适用的闸门会标为 N/A 而不是跳过

howto.what_en: After install, Claude first adds regression tests to lock current behavior, then cleans AI-generated smells (obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code, etc.) from changed files, then runs quality gates and reverts on failure.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff against merge-base main; a file list can be passed instead.

say_en.text: Deslop the changes on this branch vs main
say_en.note: Locks tests first, then cleans and verifies

say_en.text: Clean AI slop from src/foo.py and src/bar.py
say_en.note: Uses the passed file list as scope

say_en.text: Run the regression tests and quality gates after cleanup
say_en.note: Gates that are N/A are reported, not skipped
